jobs.title: Principal Product Owner
jobs.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

Position NOT available for immigration sponsorship.

GENERAL FUNCTION:
The Principal Product Owner will be responsible for collaborating with Product Manager(s), Technology, Lines of Business, Risk and other key partners to define and maximize specific bank product(s). Responsible for defining, prioritizing, and managing the development of a product that exceeds customer expectations and drives growth for the Bank. Will define, develop and lead the implementation of product roadmap deliverables, capabilities, and adoption, supporting business outcomes and lead a robust, continuous prioritization process to maximize total value, risk mitigation, and other business benefits across the Bank. At this level, the individual is expected to have a deep level of knowledge and expertise related to the product or financial industry. In some work environments, will be a key leader for SAFe (Strategic Agile Framework) methodologies and will be responsible for the value delivered by the ART (Agile Release Train) by ensuring the team backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs.  Will manage and prioritize the team’s backlog by prioritizing, articulating, and delivering new features from ideation through production release.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk assessment, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types. Support and adhere to all governance processes as defined by Enterprise.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Inspire and motivate teams to deliver on the strategy and roadmap for continuous growth and improvement of product outcomes and experience.
- Partner with other business functions, IT, Risk, Finance, Operations, and other key partners to define and execute on the product strategies.
- Establish annual goals, objectives and outcomes for product(s) and customer satisfaction; Track and monitor key performance indicators and outcomes.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gain agreement/approval/guidance, including Lines of Business, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Fraud, Architecture, and related functions.
- Act as a subject matter expert in the domain, providing guidance and support to business partners.
- Provide transparency and ongoing communications with line of business partners/key stakeholders.
- Make decisions in complex situations to drive key outcomes in support of regulatory and compliance needs, new revenue growth, process optimization, and other business-wide analytics needs.
- Solve very complex problems and make decisions in support of the team, with a focus on driving the greatest outcome for the product and the Bank.
- Engage with research team to define and implement customer usability testing, concept. validation, and co-creation studies to gain insights and identify customer needs and solutions.
- Partner closely with third parties to cultivate the relationship, understand product releases, remediate defects/outages, and ensure a seamless experience for our employees and customers.
- Maintain and provide product information to users and partners for training and other documentation.
- Actively monitor industry trends; participate in industry forums, professional associations, conferences, etc.
- If appropriate: - Lead and drive a SAFe mindset across the product teams.  Lead in this transformation across peer teams and line of business partners.
- Collaborating with SAFe teams on creating and maintaining a healthy product backlog, creating/reviewing/accepting backlog items (user stories, defects, technical spikes, etc.) and participating in team ceremonies such as sprint reviews/demos.
- Motivate teams to deliver on roadmaps for improvement of product outcomes and experience through the development of potentially releasable code in each sprint.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES REQUIRED:
- Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and related work experience.
- 8+ years of related experience.
- Expertise in strategic development and program execution.
- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt, Black Belt) desired.
- Solid product management background required; Strong presence with ability to interact with and influence all levels of the organization.
- Advanced consultative and well-articulated communication and writing skills with the ability to interact and influence at all levels of the organization.
- Deep business acumen and understanding of business processes related to your product and customers.
- Experience working in Agile or SAFE development preferred.
- Inclusive leadership skills with ability to promote a work environment that fosters creative thinking and innovation.
- Ability to have fun, a willingness to try new things and challenge the status quo through trials and an ongoing consideration of value and complexity.
- Effortlessly collaborative with strong intellectual curiosity and creative problem solving.
- Advanced analytical skills with ability to work through complex concepts/data and present well thought-out, simple solutions.
- Ability to self-motivate and work well independently and with different teams; A self-starter with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

Principal Product Owner

At Fifth Third, we understand the importance of recognizing our employees for the role they play in improving the lives of our customers, communities and each other. Our Total Rewards include comprehensive benefits and differentiated compensation offerings to give each employee the opportunity to be their best every day.

The base salary for this position is reflective of the range of salary levels for all roles within this pay grade across the U.S. Individual salaries within this range will vary based on factors such as role, relevant skillset, relevant experience, education and geographic location. jobs.title: Financial Crimes Product Owner – AML Monitoring
jobs.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:
The Financial Crimes (FC) Data and Product Management – Product Owner position is a leadership role that is responsible for assisting in the definition and implementation of Fifth Third's Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Economic Sanctions strategies. The position will oversee the defining, building, and executing technology enhancements aimed at improving Fifth Third’s AML and Economic Sanctions programs. This product owner position will focus on managing the technology and delivering technology solutions that are used to identify money laundering and predicate crimes. This role will focus
on maintaining and improving these monitoring technologies while also improving end user experience and efficiency.

Responsible and accountable for core strategic initiatives by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience while operating within the Bank's risk appetite.

This position is the product owner overseeing the enhancement and ongoing support of the bank's Anti-money Laundering tool (SAS AML). In this role, the financial crimes manager will set priority and direction for the squad supporting AML. This person will work closely with technology and Financial Crimes Investigations’ Management and the Financial Crimes Intelligence Unit (FIU) to help prioritize and set direction for the platform.  The PO is also responsible for working with other squads in the bank to set schedules and ensure that work for AML is properly aligned with those groups.  The candidate should understand the bank’s payments processes and systems as well as have a background in analytics and analysis.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Oversee and ensure timely and accurate completion of projects implementing or enhancing technology to support financial crimes as a product owner on a financial crimes squad.
- Sets priorities for the squad, balancing timeline, strategic goals, production issue resolution and other items.
- Regular reporting of squad status, accomplishments, and challenges.
- Work with subject matter experts in financial crimes to ensure that all project requirements are accurately captured and delivered.
- Develop roadmap to support new or enhanced monitoring use cases for the platform and work with partners in various areas to coordinate delivery with other squads.
- Responsible for developing, strengthening, and implementing the Line of Business compliance program in compliance with existing laws and regulations, including governance, policies and procedures, monitoring, reporting, communications, and education.
- Work with leaders of other squads to explain and prioritize critical AML projects.
- Able to prioritize both technical and business needs to ensure a highly available system that meets bank standards for security and availability.
- Be able to articulate to the Aegis squad why things are important and help train engineers and other members on the business value and reasoning for projects or efforts.
- Work with subject matter experts in financial crimes to ensure that all project requirements are accurately captured and delivered.
- Communicates significant issues to senior management.
- Liaisons with regulators as appropriate.
- Builds industry knowledge and relationships through industry networking.
- Maintains a cutting-edge awareness of division goals, regulatory and legislative developments, and industry trends.
- Works with Sr. Leadership to set strategic direction for department and then execute on those goals and objectives.
- Participates and/or leads regular meetings with peers to build and maintain knowledge of current and emerging issues and risk in the environment
- Reviewing and implementing approved solutions for the Regulatory Monitoring and Change Management program ownership.

BANK SECRECY ACT REQUIREMENTS:
Responsible for adhering to the reporting and record keeping requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering rules and regulations, observing economic sanctions by prohibiting transactions as specified by the Office of Foreign Asset Control (OFAC), following the bank’s customer identification program (CIP) rules, observing all Bank policies and procedures relating to BSA, OFAC, CIP, and related acts, and participation in ongoing related training.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Overseeing a squad to ensure optimal performance in meeting the Financial Crimes division's goals and the objectives of contributing to Bancorp’s continued success in the Financial Services industry. Assists in the recruiting process; conducts interviews and provides candid, timely feedback.  Ensures proper orientation, both formal and informal, for assigned employees.  Identifies challenging work assignments and mentoring and education programs to give employees exposure to proactive problem solving throughout the company. Develops and maintains ongoing two-way timely and clear performance feedback to maintain healthy, proactive work relationships. Encourages open dialogue that promotes creative and out of the box problem solving skills.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:
- Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience required.
- Computer/Technical: Demonstrates working or functional proficiency sufficient to apply the use of software applications (Microsoft Office Suite) without assistance and minimal supervision.
- Able to understand and conceptualize basic statistical analysis and theories.
- Solid experience manipulating (validating, correcting, reformatting, and transforming) data into multiple formats (e.g. spreadsheets, flat files, databases, etc.)
- Ability to oversee and manage technology budgets and plan for future business needs
- Strong analytical skills required to gather, assess and present quantitative and qualitative data.
- Able to develop and support conclusions and make practical recommendations to the business lines.
- Ability to develop and implement controlled, systematic step-by-step processes based on guidance and procedures.
- Ability to work independently and in a team to plan and accomplish a project or elements of a project (complexity of project scope to depend on seniority), identifying responsibilities, tasks, deadlines and pursuing their timely completion.
- Ability to work with a team, to identify and solve problems or resolve issues, including members from other units such as the Legal Department, Audit Department, or Business Unit.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills. Effectively communicates upward, downward, and laterally.
- Displays a positive business presence with both management and external contacts.
- Must be able to demonstrate sound judgment and apply logical and critical thought processes when developing and recommending solutions.

OTHER SKILLS:
- Knowledge of the bank’s payments flow process, systems, and teams.
- Ability to network with those teams to accomplish project goals.
- Possesses the ability to maintain professional composure in a dynamic work environment that often requires management of multiple and competing priorities.
- Strong SQL and data skills to support research into issues and answer regulator, audit and management questions.
- Demonstrates willingness to be a contributing and engaged member of team by sharing knowledge, working towards common goals and maintaining a positive attitude, capable of establishing effective working relationships with peers and establishes credibility with superiors and customers.
- Establish, foster, and maintain working relationships with peers and supervisory management within the Division, business lines and Information Technology support.
- Full adherence to Fifth Third's Core Values of Integrity, Teamwork and Collaboration, Respect and Inclusion, and Accountability required.

WORKING CONDITIONS:
- Normal office environment with little exposure to dust, noise, temperature, and the like.
- Extended viewing of a CRT screen.

Financial Crimes Product Owner – AML Monitoring

jobs.title: Senior HRIS Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Senior HRIS Product Analyst serves as a senior functional configuration expert and strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, and cross‑functional stakeholders. This role leads moderate to complex configuration initiatives, evaluates upcoming Workday features, and drives continuous improvement across assigned HCM domains.

Building on deep Workday functional expertise, the Senior Analyst anticipates business needs, delivers scalable solutions, and plays a key rol e in shaping how Workday supports the organization’s people processes.

Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

Workday Configuration Leadership:

- Lead configuration, testing, validation, and deployment of system changes across multiple Workday modules such as Core HR, Benefits, Talent, and Advanced Compensation.
- Own complex business process designs, configuration logic, calculated fields, and mass data updates.
- Ensure configuration aligns with system governance, best practices, and enterprise design principles.

Consultative Partnership with COEs and HRBPs:

- Act as a senior HRIS partner to assigned COEs , gathering requirements, providing solution options, and performing impact analysis.
- Translate business needs into user‑centered Workday solutions and provide guidance on process optimization.
- Influence decision‑making by presenting risks, benefits, and alternatives.

Workday Releases, Enhancements & Innovation:

- Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday releases , evaluating new functionality and identifying opportunities for system or process improvement.
- Recommend and help prioritize enhancements that improve HR service delivery.
- Share knowledge with HR colleagues and the Workday team to build broader Workday capability.

Testing & Quality Assurance:

- Lead testing for integrations, security, benefits, payroll, compensation, and other annual cycle events.
- Oversee UAT cycles, troubleshoot issues, and validate functional changes before deployment.
- Ensure all changes are thoroughly tested across upstream and downstream processes.

Data Stewardship & System Maintenance:

- Maintain master data values in Workday, including job profiles, job families, roles, organizations, and locations.
- Conduct data audits, resolve discrepancies, and ensure strong data governance practices.
- Partner with IT stakeholders and technical teams on integrations, security updates, and system fixes.

Project & Workstream Leadership:

- Lead small project teams or functional workstreams during enhancements, major updates, or cross‑functional initiatives.
- Coordinate across HR COEs, HR Operations Shared Services, IT partners, and external partners to ensure smooth execution of Workday changes.
- Provide guidance and coaching to junior HRIS analysts.

Other Duties: Performing other duties as assigned, adapting to new tasks or shifts in priorities as necessary to support your team’s and the company’s mission.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
- Five (5) + years of hands‑on experience with Workday HCM across multiple modules preferred.
- HR functional and systems experience, with strong understanding of HR processes and data.
- Experience leading configuration work, testing cycles, or project workstreams.

REQUIRED SKILLS :
Qualified candidates will possess a moderate degree of proficiency (typically from three to five years of work or practical experience), in:
- Workday Configuration Expertise: Ability to configure and manage business processes, master data structures, and module‑specific functionality.
- Advanced HR Systems Analysis: Strong requirements gathering, impact analysis, and documentation capabilities.
- Testing & Validation Leadership: Experience designing test plans and overseeing UAT cycles.
- Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to partner with HRBPs, COEs, HRIT, and technical teams.
- Communication Skills: Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to all audiences.

Please refer to the “Skills for Success” section to learn how to stand out as an applicant.
SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:
Qualified candidates will possess a moderate degree of proficiency (typically from three to five years of work or practical experience), across a suite of skills including, but not limited to:
- Strategic mindset with ability to proactively identify opportunities for system optimization.
- Strong judgment in evaluating configuration options and recommending scalable solutions.
- Ability to influence stakeholders through data, logic, and HRIS best practices.
- High level of ownership, accountability, and follow‑through.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
- Commitment to continuous learning and Workday expertise development.

DOING THE RIGHT THING: Our employees take pride in doing the right thing for customers and colleagues as well as being accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and following policies and procedures that protect all our valuable assets —including you ​ .
Senior HRIS Product Analyst
